standard_prerequisites.name: The local factorisation criterion for a map followed by a surjection onto a flat module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 3167-3177 and attributed to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the proof to peel off one summand of the relations at a time.

core_obligations: Local presentation: after passing to an open covering the proof assumes a presentation of the module by two finite free modules (proof lines 3161-3166)

Peel off one summand: at a point the factorisation criterion produces a free module through which the surjection factors and such that the composite of the relation map with it annihilates one summand of the free module of relations (proof lines 3167-3177)

Iterate: repeating the argument as many times as the rank of the module of relations yields a free module through which the surjection factors and such that the composite of the relation map with it is zero (proof lines 3178-3185)
Conclude: the vanishing of that composite exhibits a section of the surjection, so the module is a direct summand of a finite free module (proof lines 3186-3187)
proof_roadmap: 先局部设 F 有展示 O_X^{⊕r} → O_X^{⊕n} → F → 0；由平坦性判据（本卡桩 lemma-flat-eq），在 x 的某邻域上可把满射分解为 O_X^{⊕n} → O_X^{⊕n_1} → F，且复合 O_X^{⊕r} → O_X^{⊕n} → O_X^{⊕n_1} 零化 O_X^{⊕r} 的第一个直和项。
重复 r-1 次后得到 O_X^{⊕n} → O_X^{⊕n_r} → F，使复合 O_X^{⊕r} → O_X^{⊕n_r} 为零；于是满射 O_X^{⊕n_r} → F 有截面，F 是有限自由模的局部直和项。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a flat module of finite presentation on a ringed space is locally a direct summand of a finite free module (author lemma at source lines 3153-3158, label lemma-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 3160-3188) starts from a local presentation of the module, applies the flatness criterion repeatedly to peel off the summands of the module of relations one at a time, and ends with a free module through which the surjection factors with the composite of the relation map vanishing, which exhibits a section (proof lines 3167-3187). The iteration peeling off the relations is the content; the criterion applied at each step is a navigation-pointer stub. H2.
